content.rendered: Sheri adopted a manatee, Lucille, who migrates to Florida in winter to repopulate her species. Save the manatees!
Andrew loves to help people and loves getting lost in a new city.
They say you grow up to be like your parents. Since I’m working at E3, I guess they were right.
Knock knock. Who’s there? A bio.
Amanda is an adventurer at heart who values her faith and friendships and brings her passion to our team for the summer.
Ben is working hard to learn the ropes, and on his bio.
Emily is working hard for the team… and on her bio.
Travis loves learning and growing with the E3 team. He enjoys spending his free time with friends and family, as well as being in the great outdoors.
Chris enjoys the accomplishments of DIY projects, helping clients effectively conserve energy, and spending quality time with his family.
Chuck loves God, his wife, his kids and his Job in that order. He loves what he does and does what he loves. He loves the challenge of solving a problem, just call him ol’ sparky.
Pete wants to continue serving his country by making it brighter as a lighting project manager.
Rebekah helps clients maximize their energy conservation efforts. She’s also an amateur musician and part time explorer.
Justin knows HVAC. He’s been an installer, a technician, and a designer since graduating from Mississippi State in 2010. Favorite things include: Heat Transfer, the New Orleans Saints, and ice cream.
Kent thrives on developing creative solutions for clients’ energy problems. When not doing that, he enjoys time with family as well as playing hockey and volleyball.
After 12 years as a county elected official, Jason loves talking local government and helping solve problems. Especially when he can do both at the same time.
It’s all good if dad says it is.
Don’t let those Weaver boys fool you. It’s only all good when mama says it’s all good, cause everybody knows, when momma ain’t happy, ain’t nobody happy.
Jeff enjoys helping clients better understand and operate their buildings’ mechanical systems almost as much as soliciting giggles and grins from his new grand baby.
Deb enjoys spending time with her apophyllite collection under the poplars in spring.
Klip shaped our culture. He led with heart, built with purpose, and made sure we had fun along the way. Though he’s no longer steering the ship day to day, his energy still fuels the journey.
Georgia is working hard for her clients, and on a bio.
Tiffany is working hard for her clients, and on a bio.
Alex is working hard for our team, and on a bio.
Marcus is a K-12 facilities veteran who’s managed bond programs worth hundreds of millions and a knife collection worth bragging about. He’s at home in a boardroom, a deer stand, or a school hallway.
Srdan sees life in cinematic frames… including his embarrassing moments in slow motion.
Faith, family, fishing, hunting, spreadsheets, dirt bikes, podcasts, construction, analysis, planning, pack goats (yes, it’s a thing), mentoring the next generation – and making all of that fun.
Trini builds communities through teaching and organizing dance events and brings that same passion for connection and growth to People Operations.
“Recovering” school superintendent, Ryder loves good jokes and analogies, and his playlist might surprise you for a guy who wears boots and drives a big truck.
Tim will talk football with anyone…. and tackle infrastructure solutions for everyone.
Ron connects the dots for his community and cherishes time with family and friends.
Limitless Energy and a Member of Team Happy! …connecting with people, building great relationships, and enjoying family, fishing, and all the fun!

content.rendered: Rich loves a good adventure, books on tape, dad jokes, and great Tex-Mex.
Dreyvan enjoys tackling challenges and values teamwork, clear communication, and results that make a difference.

When he’s not keeping projects on track, Bryce is chasing fish, pickleball volleys, or soccer goals—sometimes all in the same weekend. He brings that same competitive spirit and team mindset to E3 every day.
Creative at heart and positive by nature, Payton loves sharing stories, connecting with people, and being outside with her family.
Katia is a traveler, foodie, and outdoor enthusiast who brings the same curiosity and energy to work.
When Tim’s not developing energy-saving initiatives, he’s growing unique heirloom crops or enjoying the great outdoors hunting.
Larry’s passionate about his customers, 80’s music, Philadelphia Eagles, and proper baseball swing mechanics.
Dan loves helping people-especially when he can help make their lives more comfortable! Just don’t ask him to help you move….he’s got to draw the line somewhere.
James’ favorite 80s TV show catchphrase, “I love it when a plan comes together,” embodies his passion for the Lord’s Plan and his own E-Team’s triumphs.
When he’s not illuminating projects, he’s illuminating the lives of his wife and son – a true master of both light fixtures and dad jokes. Balancing watts and tots with style!
Destiny is a care-free, music-loving, crazy pet mom, who lives with intention! She is grateful for each pop of color life brings.
1 wife, 3 children, 2 dogs, a parakeet, and a South Padre hermit crab acquired on vacation. Managing these with ease makes managing projects like a vacation.
When not spending time playing with his two children, Johnny is playing with fire and smoke putting out fires for his clients and smoking BBQ for his family and friends.
Mike is passionate about hunting, fishing, and 80’s hairbands, but even Motley Crue can’t rival the pride he feels making a difference in schools.
Listening to clients, overachieving their expectations, and gaining their trust is where Paul finds satisfaction. His passion is playing music and his love is his wife and kids.
Patrick enjoys finding solutions for clients that will save on operating costs. He also spends quite a bit of time watching his daughter compete in gymnastics.
Duncan loves his ever growing car and motorcycle collection, but his true colors show under the LED light that he installed above you!
Matt is a musician and at-home gourmet drawn to anything electrical or mechanical. He loves tapping into his creativity to solve problems.
Ryan enjoys wood-working, welding, and weightlifting. He can also be found teaching differential equations and engineering concepts to his wife and son.
Jonathan is an aspiring engineer ready to take on the world. He enjoys spending time with family, working out, and going to the movies.

Trenton is a proud girl dad with a hands‑on mindset. He enjoys the outdoors, tinkering on vehicles, and tending livestock, and brings that same practical thinking and attention to detail into every project.
Ben loves travel and adventure. Seeing new places or striving to make his clients efficient and happy is all thrilling action in his eyes.

Matt is a husband, dad, poppa, Christ follower, foodie, espresso snob, and excel nerd with a big heart and a bigger sense of humor who enjoys solving all kinds of problems and optimizing all the things.
Although the spiders he’s encountered hiding around mechanical equipment are decidedly not radioactive, Brian is proud to be your friendly neighborhood energy engineer! (Super powers pending)
When Jim isn’t processing or analyzing data, he is an avid player of board and card games, which requires processing and analyzing data.

Sebastian is a detail-oriented engineer and takes pride in providing quality solutions. When he is not working, Sebastian loves spending time outside hiking, biking, and paddle boarding with his family.
The extra “E” in Keven’s name is for the added effort he demonstrates in developing effective projects and efficiency improvements for clients.

Dennis honored God with his life, a beautiful love for his wife and children, a passion for treating people with honor and respect, and a desire to be the very best at all he did. Dennis was one of the best and we miss him dearly.
Steven loves helping others achieve success. When he’s not focusing on client goals, his goal is to spend as much time on the lake with his family as possible.
Vince always finds time for his family, solutions for his clients, and the closest Whataburger.
Jared is a wannabe triathlete that can swim, but runs with two left feet. He loves wasting his energy racing while saving his clients’ energy.
Mike enjoys the challenge of endurance sports and helping clients accomplish their goals. Sometimes those are one in the same.
Bill is most proud of his beautiful family. ‘All this time we didn’t realize we were making memories, we just knew we were having fun!’

Lance loves helping his clients achieve their vision. He adores his family and the time he spends with them, whether traveling or introducing his grandkids to the traditions of Texas AandM at football games.
Adam is always smiling and is extremely proud of his family. If you tell Adam not to talk to strangers, his wife will say “he’s never met one!”
After the numbers are crunched, Colin enjoys spending time with his beautiful wife, playing hockey and cuddling up with his little black cat.
Luisa is happy when she has a place for everything and everything is in its place.
Pat is often the first face seen and the voice most often heard with multi-tasking as her middle name.
From Navy rescue swimmer to helicopter pilot, master electrician to homesteader, Jason brings true Renaissance Man energy to every project.
Eric is no longer fairly confident he would win an E3 dance competition. Good moves managing projects have also won his clients’ confidence.
Donald loves making buildings work, clients happy, and saving energy almost as much as he loves catching Crappie and Red Fish.

Brian is a process innovator, Excel master, and energy detective. He’s been developing sustainable energy savings projects since Aikman won his last Super Bowl. His daughters are his greatest treasure.
With 30+ years in the energy efficiency business, Steve is passionate about collecting energy savings for clients. He is also passionate about collecting rocks and fossils in his spare time.
Greg was given the task of writing a bio. He quickly discovered his inability to process simple tasks without the aid of Excel and light fixtures.
As a storyteller, Jason loves a good yarn. He especially likes untangling the knots.
When Justin isn’t turning bright ideas into beautiful spaces, he is a veteran, husband and dad, calling audibles on Sundays and reeling in memories the rest of the week.
Cindy is a control freak…at least when it comes to E3’s money. Teamwork at E3 makes her job fun and rewarding.
Don was an E3 Founding Father. And, like many dads, Don nurtured E3 from our roots, patiently helped us grow, and then took off for the fishing boat as soon as he knew we could succeed in life.
Jeff loves his family and the western lifestyle they live. Although it requires much from his family, the reward of that effort is great.
Daniel is a part of the best engineering group in the industry and finds solutions for his clients’ issues.
Chalo is passionate about technology, energy savings, and a great steak.
Baking enthusiast here to whip up win-win scenarios while keeping things sweet and fun.
Josh brings decades of experience delivering infrastructure solutions. He leads with clarity, focus, and just enough mischief to keep things interesting.
